title: The lodge of Diamond in Armagh the splendid behung with corpses of papishes
html_source: Battle of The Diamond, 21 Sept 1795, led to the Orange Order. The Diamond is a mainly protestant district in County Armagh

anchor.text: The lodge of Diamond in Armagh the splendid behung with corpses of papishes

anchor.suffix:
